notes.title: Quintessential Beauties Live!
notes.content:
If you have enjoyed Maid Cafe and its accompanying adult comic books then why not check out the Maid Games teams latest Book project a stand alone story that features many of the characters from the Maid Cafe game in a new original story of demons, desire and love... Well maybe more lust than love.

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/maidgames/qbeauties][img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33021098/52d1c60bc2204fe0b59cdddc5e03c01c8322e712.png[/img][/url]

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/maidgames/qbeauties][img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33021098/724367c7c8415c8bd811e5a1a3e60c8d7d5de5fe.png[/img][/url]

The campaign also offers a variety of other items, including a second chance to order the collectors edition copies of their past adult graphic novels. Checkout the campaign now on Kickstarter:

notes.title: Maid Cafe Release
notes.content:
We are happy to announce the official release date for upcoming adult game Maid Cafe... You can look forward to playing the game in full on the 25th August 2023. 

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33021098/3fe6184f9887899da32c04fb0feb4f501d8f5dc5.png[/img]

Make sure you wishlist the game now to be notified on release, so that you can enjoy the biggest game we have published. Maid Games have done an amazing job with the development of this game.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33021098/28b5f5aa9e28f131d54905c498d548df9af977b9.png[/img]

It features almost half a million words of dialogue and scripting, over 35 characters to meet and have sexy fun with, plus over 1000 adult illustrations to unlock and enjoy, plus the chance to explore the town, buy items from shops, visit local destinations, go on dates, practice your desserts, learn new recipes and compete in a bake off competition!

Wishlist it now and don't miss out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/423640/Maid_Cafe/

Deluxe Bundles and Discounts available on release, the game also comes with trading cards and Achievements to unlock.

notes.title: V1.5 Release
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that the full kinetic graphic novel of Keiji Light has now been released as part of the Echo Tokyo: Intro version 1.5 update.

This update includes the entire kinetic graphic novel of Keiji Light, which has every line fully voice acted by professionals as it was with the Shizume origin story.

In addition we have added a new achievement for reading the Keiji origin story.

This tells a darker story and gives more insights into the games setting.

In addition the new story adds a new page to the image database within the game, bringing the total amount of images to unlock up to 160.

The store page has also been updated accordingly.

notes.title: Keiji's Story
notes.content:
With Shizume's Story now completed we have begun work on the second story of the game. the main outline has been completed as well as the base artwork, leaving just the final script and voice acting to be created.

Keiji's story will add another 6000 word or more storyline to the game introducing the background behind a second character from the Echo Tokyo universe.

This second story should be released around mid-end of February.

And will be accompanied by another DLC pack as well.

notes.title: Shizume's Intro
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that the first story of Echo Tokyo Intro has now been completed and fully tested and includes:
[list]
[*]6,000 word story introducing Shizume
[*]80 unlockable images
[*]Full voice-acting of every line.
 - Includes, narration, speech and thoughts.
[*]5 Achievements to enjoy.
[*]Several choices that alter the story.
[/list]

In addition the original graphic light novel is available to purchase separately, this has its own version of the story written by a separate writer in prose rather than in the game format. The DLC will be available to purchase on release alongside the main title.
